scene.ko: 3주 머무는 이유를 묻는 심사관에게 돌아갈 표, 숙소, 연수 서류를 보여 주며 차분히 설명한다.

lines.en: You said you'll be here for three weeks. Do you have a return ticket?
Yes, I do. I can show it to you on my phone.
alt: Yes. I have it on my phone.
Yes, I can show you on my phone.

lines.en: Thank you. Your hotel booking only covers the first week. Where will you stay after that?
lines.ko: 감사합니다. 호텔 예약이 첫 주만 되어 있네요. 그다음에는 어디에서 지내실 건가요?

lines.en: After that, I'm taking a training course at a university, and they've arranged a dormitory for me.
lines.ko: 그 뒤에는 대학교에서 연수를 받는데, 학교에서 기숙사를 마련해 줬어요.
alt: Then I'll attend a training course at a university, and I'll stay in their dormitory.

lines.en: A training course? Will you be paid while you're here?
lines.ko: 연수요? 여기 있는 동안 돈을 받으시나요?

lines.en: No, I won't. It's a short teacher training program, and my school in Korea is covering the cost.
lines.ko: 아니요. 짧은 교사 연수 프로그램이고, 비용은 한국에 있는 제 학교가 내요.
alt: No. It's a short program for teachers, and my school in Korea is paying for it.

lines.en: Do you have any documents for that?
Yes, here's the invitation letter from the university. It includes the program dates.
lines.ko: 네, 대학교에서 받은 초청장이 여기 있어요. 프로그램 날짜도 나와 있어요.
alt: Yes, this is the invitation letter from the university. The dates are on it.

lines.en: That's fine. One more thing — are you bringing any food into the country?
lines.ko: 됐습니다. 하나 더요, 음식을 가지고 들어오시나요?

lines.en: Just some packaged snacks. I declared them on the form.
lines.ko: 포장된 과자 몇 개뿐이에요. 신고서에 적었어요.
alt: Only some packaged snacks. I wrote them on the declaration form.

expressions.en: I can show it to you on my phone.
expressions.note: on my phone = 휴대폰에 있는 것을

expressions.en: I declared them on the form.
